text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=dedicated-tenant-latency, severity=P1, tenant=CedarlineApps, cluster=cedarline-reserved-3. symptom=95th latency > 2.0s, 5xx rate spike 4x baseline. alertid=PD-78321 :rotating_light:

pd-bot: PD incident created: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-78321 — paging primary oncall.

Alex (oncall): acked. I'm on it. seeing the grafana dash now — 95th hitting ~2.8s for last 10m.

Priya (SRE): FYI Cedarline had a deployment 22m ago, but CPU/mem look normal. throughput increased ~1.6x. Could be autoscale not kicking due to reserved pool cap.

Alex (oncall): confirmed reserved pool usage at 100% for cedarline-reserved-3. burst queue growing. host-level I/O ok.

Lee (runtime): jumping in — routing shows a lot of requests pinned to high-context models (redwood-xxl) for this tenant. fallback policy should route to redwood-medium when latency spikes, but the policy might be stalled.

Maya (eng): pinging the rollout that changed model-mapping 22m ago. No intentional config to bypass fallback. sending logs.

Sam (Customer Ops): CedarlineApps reports customer-facing slowdowns and some 500s. They're seeing timeouts in their user flows (checkout). They're asking for ETA / mitigation.

Alex (oncall): immediate mitigation actions in progress:
- applying temporary tenant-level throttle to reduce concurrency
- enabling forced fallback to redwood-medium for CedarlineApps
- adding 2 burst slots to reserved pool (if infra accepts)

Alex (oncall): running command to set forced fallback:```
# force tenant mapping to fallback model
redwoodctl tenant update-mapping --tenant cedarline --force-fallback redwood-medium --reason "latency P1"
```

Priya (SRE): I can add burst slots via infra API. doing:```
POST /infra/reserved-pools/cedarline-reserved-3/adjust 
{ "add_slots": 2, "reason": "P1 burst" }
```
(If this fails, we'll need host-level scaling which takes longer)

Lee (runtime): cache pressure observed — KV cache hitrate for cedarline down 15% over baseline, likely due to model variant change. flushing tenant KV cache for cedarline now to reduce tail latency.

Maya (eng): confirmed the mapping update succeeded; fallback traffic now ~60% routing to redwood-medium. Latency 95th dropped to ~1.4s for the last 2m. 5xx rate down 50%.

Alex (oncall): burst slot add succeeded (2 slots added). burst queue drained partially.

Sam (Customer Ops): relaying to Cedarline: "We've applied temporary measures (fallback + throttle + burst slots). Services are improving; we'll monitor and follow up with a postmortem." They asked for approximate time until full recovery — told them 30-60m while we stabilize.

Priya (SRE): still seeing a small tail of errors from older in-flight requests. I'll watch for any regressions. Starting a gentle rolling restart of 3 workers on cedarline-reserved-3 to clear possible corruption:```
redwoodctl cluster restart-workers --cluster cedarline-reserved-3 --count 3 --grace 45s
```

Lee (runtime): KV flush finished, restart started. routing metrics show steady improvements.

Alex (oncall): PD note: acknowledged and incident set to "mitigating". tagging owners: @eng-runtime, @sre.

pd-bot: PagerDuty status update: PD-78321 marked acknowledged by Alex.

Maya (eng): watch for any config flip-flop from the deployment 22m ago — if mapping reverts, it will reintroduce the pressure. I'm adding a temporary guard in the mapping service to prevent automatic rollback.

Priya (SRE): rolling restarts completed. cluster CPU and latency stabilized. No more elevated 5xx in the past 5m.

Alex (oncall): considering this largely mitigated. moving to post-incident monitoring. Next: create a follow-up to review autoscale thresholds and mapping rollback safeguard.

Sam (Customer Ops): Cedarline confirmed end-user performance is back to normal and thanked the team. They requested a short writeup for their incident tracker.

Alex (oncall): creating a brief incident note and assigning postmortem actions. PD incident will stay open for 30m of quiet. If no regressions, we'll resolve.

pd-bot: PD-78321: status update queued.

incident-bot: Alert suppressed for cedarline-reserved-3 while monitoring.

Alex (oncall): handoff to Priya for overnight watch in 20m. Priya, please acknowledge when you take over.

Priya (SRE): ack — I'll own monitoring and postmortem writeup. adding runbook link: https://confluence.example/runbooks/dedicated-latency.

pd-bot: PD-78321 resolved by Priya (SRE) at 5201112840.

Alex (oncall): thanks all. good mitigation work. :thumbsup:
